items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Prez told Herschel, "Why don't you go and make it, Herschel?"

ctx.x: Yeah. Prez told Herschel, "Why don't you go and make it, Herschel?" Herschel said, "No, man, I can't make it." Herschel didn't read too good. He said, "You'all make it." They called him Red. They didn't call him Prez in Kansas City; they called him Red.
Why did they call him that?
